{{Top|leg}}
'''Congressman''' was a term used to describe [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] and [[Junior Representative/Legends|Associate Planetary Representatives]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic]] and [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senates]]. The term could refer to them separately or collectively.
